html:
The founder of North Korea, who ruled it from 1948 until his death in 1994. He started the Korean War and built a family dictatorship around a cult of his own person.

He was born near Pyongyang under Japanese rule. As a young man he fought as a communist guerrilla against the Japanese in Manchuria, then fled to the Soviet Union around 1940 and served in the Red Army.

In 1945 Soviet forces occupied the north of Korea and backed him as leader. In 1948 he became premier of the new Democratic People's Republic of Korea. In June 1950, with Stalin's approval, he invaded the South, starting the Korean War. Chinese troops saved him from defeat, and the 1953 armistice left Korea split into two states.

He then purged all rivals and built a tightly controlled state under the ideology of Juche, self-reliance. He was honoured as the Great Leader, and his son Kim Jong Il succeeded him, the first communist dynasty. He is still called the country's Eternal President.
sum: The founder of North Korea, who ruled it from 1948 until his death in 1994. He started the Korean War and built a family dictatorship around a cult of his own person.
